vh-4-1-3-2.title: The Frozen Pack-Goat
vh-4-1-3-2.text: Stubborn hooves refuse the turn until you haul on the leading rope, coaxing Biscuit past the rigid carcass of a pack-goat wedged tight into a blue-veined crevice. The cold is a physical presence here, biting at your knuckles through wet wool while the bronze Clapper hums a low, sympathetic vibration against your spine. Keeping your eyes fixed strictly ahead on the shifting grey horizon, you guide the mule forward through the treacherous cleft as the wind howls down the ice-chute.
exits: Face the sheer blue-white glass wall
Negotiate the narrow wind-lashed ice-ledge
Listen to the humming suspension cable

vh-4-1-3-3.title: The Volcanic Vein
vh-4-1-3-3.text: A dark ribbon of volcanic ash slices straight through the pale glacier ice, offering your numbed boots sudden, gritty purchase on the slick, upward-sloping path. You lean into the slope, the heavy bronze tongue shifting in its leather cradle with a dull, resonant thud that jars your shoulder blades. Biscuit picks a cautious way behind you, ears pinned back against the howling gale.
exits: Steer the mule along the ledge
Heed the humming overhead cable
Climb onto the sulfur-scented rock shelf

vh-4-1-3-4.title: Securing the Bronze
vh-4-1-3-4.text: Fingers clumsy with frost, you haul hard on the leather straps of the clapper cradle as a violent mounting vibration threatens to work the heavy bronze free from its padding. The metal sings a thin, complaining note against the gale, demanding your full attention to keep it lashed securely to your frame. Biscuit huddles close against your flank, shaking a crust of rime from his grey muzzle while you double-knot the harness.
exits: Guide the mule along the icy ledge
Test the straining overhead cable span

vh-4-1-3-5.title: The Meltwater Tunnel
vh-4-1-3-5.text: Half-buried in a drift of crystalline snow near the shadowed mouth of a dark meltwater drainage tunnel, a heavy, rusted winch-handle left by the Cable Court catches the pale light. Water drips with a slow, hollow rhythm from the frozen vault above, echoing the faint hum of the Clapper on your back. You pause for a heartbeat to catch your breath in the sheltered gloom before pressing forward.
exits: Follow the path beneath the humming cable
Climb up to the sulfur-scented stone shelf

vh-4-1-3-6.title: The Cornice Edge
vh-4-1-3-6.text: You edge carefully along a treacherous cornice of wind-blown powder that overhangs a thousand-foot vertical drop into the mist-shrouded gorge of the lower glacier. Every step must be tested twice to ensure the snow-bridge holds your weight and the heavy bronze burden on your back. Below you, the abyss churns with white vapour and the faint, haunting echo of falling ice.
exits: Scramble up to the high rock shelf
Press flat against the freezing wall

vh-4-1-3-7.title: The Ptarmigan Flurry
vh-4-1-3-7.text: A sudden explosion of gray mountain ptarmigan bursts straight out from a snow-pocket right beneath your boots, startling the mule with a frantic beating of wings. Biscuit rears back sharply, nearly tipping your heavy bronze burden sideways into the drift. You grab his halter-strap with a shouted warning, planting your heels firmly into the hard-packed crust until the flurry passes.
exits: Lead the mule across the narrow ledge
Pull yourself up to the rocky shelf

vh-4-1-3-8.title: The Firn Trench
vh-4-1-3-8.text: You carve a hasty trench into the hard firn snow with your belt-hatchet, crouching low to shelter behind its icy lip while a violent squall of needle-ice rakes the exposed mountain face. The wind shrieks overhead like a trapped spirit, driving frozen pellets into the wool of your hood. Biscuit presses his nose into your shoulder, sharing your meager shelter until the worst of the whiteout passes.
exits: Crawl out onto the sulfur-scented shelf
Leap across the broken hanging ladder
Flatten against the freezing rock face

vh-4-1-3-9.title: The Lowgate Signpost
vh-4-1-3-9.text: A sturdy wooden signpost carved with deep, weather-worn letters by Lowgate artisans points down through the thickening murk toward the lower ladder stations and the distant valley floor. The painted arrows are crusted with rime, but the carved destination remains unmistakably clear. You wipe the frost from the wood with a mittened thumb, measuring the remaining daylight against the long descent ahead.
exits: Haunt the high rock shelf above
Attempt the leap across the broken ladder
Hug the freezing wall against the gust

vh-4-1-3-10.title: Numbed Fingers
vh-4-1-3-10.text: You check your fingers one by one for feeling as the biting frost stiffens the knitted wool of your mittens and turns your ragged breath to rattling crystals. The cold seeps deep into your bones, making the straps of the clapper cradle feel heavier with every passing stride. Stamping your feet against the packed ice, you force your stiff joints to move once more along the trail.
exits: Press against the wall for the final push
Enter the thick bank of freezing fog

vh-4-1-3-11.title: The Frozen Blanket
vh-4-1-3-11.text: A discarded woollen blanket frozen stiff as a rigid board blocks your footing on the narrow track, forcing you to hack it loose with short, sharp blows from your belt-hatchet. Shards of ice fly into the air as the fabric finally tears free and tumbles down the precipice. You steady Biscuit against the resulting shudder of the slope before taking your next step forward into the wind.
exits: Lean into the freezing stone wall
Plunge into the oncoming freezing fog
